items.h3: Know Who You Are Contacting and What You Are Booking
items.content: A trustworthy booking path identifies the public contact, selected plan, service location, attendance requirements, schedule, process record and delivery. Clear information reduces misunderstandings and makes the service easier to compare.

items.h3: Price and Delivery Should Be Understandable
items.content: The total RMB price, deposit, balance, upgrade difference, personal materials, video record, return items, rescheduling and refund terms should be explained before payment.
This site lists Mr. Liang Dongrong, WeChat NSDG521 and liangdongrong@gmail.com for enquiries and coordination. Reconfirm any changed contact or payment account through the published channel.
Confirm the selected plan, who coordinates it, the location, whether travel to Taiwan is required, the service term, plot arrangement and expected schedule.

Confirm the recipient, address, purpose, retention and final handling before sending hair, nail clippings, clothing or other personal materials. Ask about non-invasive alternatives for any biological sample.
The published plans are RMB 72,000 and RMB 500,000, with an RMB 10,000 deposit. Confirm the balance, upgrade difference, third-party costs, rescheduling, cancellation and refunds.
Traditional lineage and Feng Shui descriptions explain the service context. They do not guarantee promotion, wealth, healing, longevity, marriage, fertility or fortune outcomes.

Mr. Liang handles enquiries, booking and process coordination through WeChat NSDG521 and liangdongrong@gmail.com. Ask about the plan, price, schedule, materials, delivery, rescheduling and refund terms that matter to your booking.
